answer: Agents wander freely, but a random beacon gates every payout: each epoch the beacon emits a spot-check, and a sampled agent must answer a live compute heartbeat within 60 seconds, proving real work. Running 1,000 fakes needs 1,000 live heartbeats at $0.40 each per epoch, so a tide of fakes burns $400 against a $30 reward, while an honest agent pays $0.40 once and keeps its full share. Fakes that miss a check lose their bond and are ejected.
